correctness.rationale: The general Cov(K,M_r) moment formula follows from binomial occupancy marginal and two-cell multinomial joint probabilities, with diagonal exclusion. Integer H_{14,r} signs were cross-checked by an independent multinomial-state enumerator. Max-positive/max-negative base comparisons establish four strict signs for all n=10t,t>=15; since one dominant power exceeds the sum of at most nine opposing powers, the argument is infinite rather than empirical. For m=2 the elementary M_0M_r=0 and M_n=M_0 identities prove exact minimality. The neighborhood statement follows from strict polynomial inequalities. Checker passed 1642 exact assertions but is supplementary.

value.rationale: Richness K and exact-r frequency spectrum M_r are interpretable categorical-sampling observables. The infinite robust three-switch example is a structural obstruction to extending the known single-threshold law from uniform bins to arbitrarily heterogeneous bins. The accompanying minimal-three-bin boundary adds a natural complete classification of smallest possible model size. The result is not justified merely by exact small-case arithmetic.
